tldr: The Moon through the 7th house sensitizes partners, close friends, clients, conflict, and attraction.
body:
When the Moon moves through your 7th house, it makes you more sensitive to partners, close friends, clients, conflict, attraction, and what other people bring out in you. You may notice more through direct encounters with other people: what feels mutual, what feels unfair, and what someone else is reflecting back.

A need, mood, habit, or private reaction may become harder to ignore. It can help you read what you need before the feeling gets louder.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for seeing relationship patterns while they are active, not just after the fact.

The caution: Watch for treating a temporary mood as the whole truth. The risk is making the other person the whole problem or the whole solution.

The Moon moves through this house for a few days. Treat the feeling as information. Give it a grounded place to land before you react from it.
